validation_scope: Exact on-device phrase cache: language/text isolation, bounded LRU, clearing and stale completion guard.
Actual model output reused for an exact repeat, then cleared on close; real offline native translator reload.
FAST and COMPLETE speech capture from a separate player UID without screen subtitles and actual Chinese output.
Real overlay history entry; manual resync button restarts capture and continues Chinese captions, retains recent history, ignores old capture stop callbacks.
Japanese model download, native model reload and translation without network.
MediaProjection cancellation and overlay approval order.
Blocked frame worker during stop retains ImageReader until queued native work returns, then releases resources.
Existing queue ordering, display backpressure, voice and UI regressions.
limitations: Real user phone and Bluetooth headset have not been tested.
No measured speech accuracy percentage, speedup factor or fixed end-to-end latency claim.
Player must permit AudioPlaybackCapture; models need network on first preparation.
User-triggered resync intentionally skips unfinished speech and waiting captions; completed recent translations remain.
A bounded queue rejects new speech under sustained overload with a visible warning.
